pwf.bands.subtitle.text: The days left at which a deadline turns green, yellow and red, for each source of alerts. A rule has versions and is approved by a different person from the maker.
pwf.bands.links.label: Links of the screen
pwf.bands.readOnly.text: You can only look at this policy: editing needs the permission to write governance rules and a session that is not read-only.
pwf.bands.source.title: Source of alerts
pwf.bands.source.label: Source of alerts
pwf.bands.base.blank: There is no policy for this source yet: enter new thresholds.
pwf.bands.base.rule: Continuing from version {version}, which is in force.
pwf.bands.base.default: Continuing from the default thresholds of the system.
pwf.bands.unverified.hint: These default thresholds have not been confirmed by the owner of the process; review them before submitting.
pwf.bands.unit.label: Unit of the days
pwf.bands.unit.hint: The source "{source}" counts in {unit}; a rule with another unit is refused.
pwf.bands.ladder.title: The three thresholds
pwf.bands.green.label: Green: up to (days left)
pwf.bands.green.hint: Leave empty: every deadline with more days left than the yellow line is green.
pwf.bands.green.formula: Green when the days left do not exceed this threshold and are above the yellow one; empty means every number above the yellow line is green (BR-PWF-20).
pwf.bands.yellow.label: Yellow: up to (days left)
pwf.bands.yellow.hint: With no more days left than this the deadline turns yellow.
pwf.bands.yellow.formula: Yellow when the days left do not exceed this threshold and are above the red one (BR-PWF-20).
pwf.bands.red.label: Red: up to (days left)
pwf.bands.red.hint: From -1: 0 is red on the day it falls due and after; -1 is red only once overdue.
pwf.bands.red.formula: Red when the days left do not exceed this threshold; a negative number is overdue (BR-PWF-20).
pwf.bands.info.source: Rule BR-PWF-20 of the project workflow module
pwf.bands.overrides.title: Overrides by kind of task, priority and phase
pwf.bands.overrides.hint: The first override that matches wins. "Any" means the criterion is not looked at. At most 20 overrides.
pwf.bands.override.kind.label: Kind of task
pwf.bands.override.priority.label: Priority
pwf.bands.override.phase.label: Phase
pwf.bands.override.phase.hint: Code of a phase of the template; leave empty for any.
pwf.bands.reminders.title: Reminders and escalation
pwf.bands.reminders.label: Reminder days (days left)
pwf.bands.reminders.hint: Falling, at most 6, for example 5, 2, 0, -1; each one reminds exactly once.
pwf.bands.escalate.label: Escalate after (days overdue)
pwf.bands.escalate.hint: Leave empty: no escalation by days overdue.
pwf.bands.preview.title: What the thresholds do
pwf.bands.preview.owner.label: The example of the owner
pwf.bands.preview.blocked.text: Fix the order of the thresholds (green above yellow, yellow above red) to see the preview.
pwf.bands.preview.examples.label: The colour at some days left
pwf.bands.preview.thresholds.text: Thresholds the server applies: green {green}, yellow {yellow}, red {red}.
pwf.bands.preview.formula: The server puts each number of days left against the three thresholds: red when it does not exceed the red one, yellow the yellow one, green the green one, not yet in range above that.
pwf.bands.problem.order.error: The thresholds must fall: green above yellow, yellow above red.
pwf.bands.problem.unitMismatch.error: The unit must be the unit of the source of alerts.
pwf.bands.problem.phase.error: A phase code is capital letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
pwf.bands.problem.reminderOrder.error: The reminders must fall and never repeat.
